{{Quote|The resistance fighters have a lot of support. Rumor is, the Republic never really left.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:TBT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Balmorran Target|the D5-Mantis}}</ref>}}
The '''Balmorran resistance''' was formed by [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] citizens and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in order to force the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] from their [[Planet/Legends|world]].

==History==
{{Quote|Reports indicate that the Republic forces that stayed on Balmorra after we invaded are training resistance fighters at the Balmorran Arms Factory. [...] They're terrorists and criminals. If not for the Republic's aid, they'd be harmless.|[[Lieutenant Major]] [[Pirrell]]|<ref name="TOR:BaS">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Bait and Switch|Balmorra}}</ref>}}
After the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] was granted to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Due to this, all [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces still on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Great Galactic War]] were supposed to leave the planet, but some managed to stay behind. These [[Republic soldier|soldiers]] banded together with Balmorran citizens to form the Balmorran Resistance movement, whose main goal was to end the Empire's occupation of Balmorra.

The Resistance would carry out [[Guerrilla warfare/Legends|guerrilla warfare]] against the Imperial occupation. Not just [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were carrying out these tactics, but regular citizens as well. This made it more difficult for the Empire to discover who was a part of the Resistance, because it could have been anyone. Thousands of these members would also use dangerous and hidden locations that the Empire would never suspect, to meet and train, making detection even harder.

Not all of the Balmorran people agreed with the Resistance, and felt they were abandoned by the Republic and should accept the Empire and its [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Darth Lachris]]. Those that were a part of the Resistance, however, would have done anything to remove it from the planet, even [[Death/Legends|die]].
